rawFindings.title: Incorrect fallback used in population model name determination
rawFindings.explanation: In the population helper function, the determination of the model name to use for the populate query was changed from using `options.model || schema.options.ref || model.modelName` to only `options.model || schema.options.ref`. The prior fallback to `model.modelName` was removed. This breaks cases where no explicit model or schema ref is given but the model instance has a modelName property that should be used, causing population to fail with an "unable to determine model name" error.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore fallback to `model.modelName` in addition to `options.model` and `schema.options.ref` when determining the populate model name.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Attempting to populate a path without an explicit model or ref in schema on a document/model that previously relied on using `model.modelName` for model resolution will now fail with an error instead of populating correctly.
